Third-party notices for nam-engine.wasm
=======================================

nam-engine.wasm is the unmodified WebAssembly build shipped in the npm package
neural-amp-modeler-wasm 3.0.7 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 TONE3000; see
LICENSE-neural-amp-modeler-wasm.txt beside this file). Its README states it is a
port of NeuralAmpModelerCore built against v0.5.4, unmodified. That library and
the dependencies it pins at v0.5.4 are compiled into the binary:

1. NeuralAmpModelerCore v0.5.4
   https://github.com/sdatkinson/NeuralAmpModelerCore
   MIT License, Copyright (c) 2023 Steven Atkinson

2. AudioDSPTools (git submodule of NeuralAmpModelerCore v0.5.4)
   https://github.com/sdatkinson/AudioDSPTools
   MIT License, Copyright (c) 2023 Steven Atkinson

3. nlohmann/json 3.12.0 (single header, Dependencies/nlohmann/json.hpp)
   https://github.com/nlohmann/json
   MIT License, Copyright (c) 2013-2025 Niels Lohmann

4. Eigen (git submodule of NeuralAmpModelerCore v0.5.4, commit
   bc3b39870ecb690a623a3f49149a358b95c5781d)
   Mozilla Public License 2.0 — https://www.mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
   Source code: https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen (that commit). Crow Studio
   ships Eigen only as compiled into nam-engine.wasm and does not modify it.
